The orchestrator (#4267) needs an entrepreneur problem mapped to a canonical PH-P. No signal could ever win, so Instagram had no frozen winner and no media job for 26 and 27 October.

Materializer writes approved_canonical_problem_id and the library scene so the existing frozen-winner resolver takes the library-mapping route
